summary.text: Amy Nielsen is a Democratic state representative from Iowa House District 85 who has served in the Iowa House since 2017 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
Ballotpedia notes that she has served as mayor of North Liberty, Iowa.

paragraphs.text: Amy Nielsen was born in Keokuk, Iowa, and graduated from Iowa City West High School in 1995.

She has served as mayor of North Liberty, as the Iowa state director of the National Foundation of Women Legislators, on the Iowa City Community School District's Equity Advisory Committee, the Community Education Districtwide Advisory Council and the Johnson County Metropolitan Planning Organization, and on the North Liberty Community Pantry Board of Directors.
She has also been affiliated with the Garner Elementary Walking School Bus program and the Iowa City Blue Zones Project.
Nielsen took office in the Iowa House in 2017 and won re-election in District 77 in 2018 and 2020.
In the redrawn District 85 she defeated Wayne Grell and Jacob Wenck in 2022 and won again in 2024.
For 2025-2026 Ballotpedia shows her assigned to the Administration and Rules, House Appropriations, Natural Resources and House State Government committees.
She advanced from the June 2, 2026 Democratic primary and is listed as the candidate in the general election.
